meta.name: win-loss-analysis
meta.description: Analyze sales-call transcripts to extract why deals are won and lost across six dimensions — product, messaging, GTM/sales, pricing, competition, and customer context. Produces aggregated patterns with verbatim buyer quotes, frequencies, and recommendations. Writes to marketing/win-loss/win-loss.md as the evidence base under positioning, messaging, and ICP. Triggers - "win loss analysis", "why are we losing deals", "why do we win", "analyze sales calls", "churn analysis", "deal review"
